en: Looker
Good day. I am a clerk, and I know nothing. Nothing at all. Please come back...
...Ah. It is you, {player}! You see through my disguise at once. A fine eye, as always.
Yes, it is I, Looker. The Bureau is closed, which is why this is not the Bureau.
This is the Open Door Agency. Anyone with a puzzle may walk in, and I take a case in each region whose Champion you are.
{player}, you are here! Strange news from the harbour. Boats from every region have been sailing to Grayfall Islet.
On them, the leaders of the old villain teams. Each one heard that their old machine had come back, hidden in the keep out there.
Somebody gathered them on purpose. I must know who. And I would feel much braver with a Champion beside me.
My boat is at the quay. Shall we sail to Grayfall Keep?
{player} sailed with Looker to Grayfall Islet...
A case from Sinnoh. Before every party at the Resort Area's villa, food vanishes from its larder.
The villa's caretaker blames a young Gible that plays nearby. I do not believe it. A Gible does not read crate labels.
Will you take the case of the Villa Larder?
Excellent! Speak to the caretaker in the Resort Area, and to the girl whose Gible is blamed. The ferry's people at the Fight Area may know something too.
Come back when you have found the clues. Then we deduce!
You have every clue! Now, we think. First question.
Precisely! Those marks were cut by a crowbar, not a Gible's teeth. The little one is innocent.
Second question, and the important one.
Yes! Two hours missing from the ferry's log, every party night. Only its captain could sail off his course unwritten.
Captain Ferren Dray. He will be on the Fight Area's pier. Go and face him, {player}. I would come, but I am a clerk today.
Captain Ferren Dray waits on the Fight Area's pier. Go and face him!
There are clues still to find. The caretaker and the girl in the Resort Area, the ferry's people on the Fight Area's pier.
The captain came to my door and owned up to everything. The villa will have its parties, and the Gible its good name.
The case of the Villa Larder is closed! Here is the agency's fee, with my thanks.
When you are Champion of another region, come back. The door is always open.
A case from Kanto. On the ferry to the Sevii Islands, one seat is paid for on every sailing. And on every sailing, it is empty.
The crew say a ghost rides in it. Ghosts do not buy tickets, {player}. Somebody does.
Will you take the case of the Ferry's Extra Passenger?
Excellent! Speak to the ticket clerk and the old fisherman on Vermilion City's quay. Something was left behind on Two Island too.
Come back when you have found the clues. Then we deduce!
You have every clue! Now, we think. First question.
Precisely! The office tears its stubs on the left. That one was torn on the right. Someone else sells passage on that ferry.
Second question, and the important one.
Yes! A last traveller waved up the cargo ramp after the count. The seat stays empty because the passenger rides in the hold!
Dov Harlan, the dockhand. He will be on Vermilion City's quay. Go and face him, {player}. I am needed here, filing.
Dov Harlan the dockhand waits on Vermilion City's quay. Go and face him!
There are clues still to find. The ticket clerk and the fisherman on Vermilion's quay, and the harbour on Two Island.
Dov came to my door. He paid for that seat at the office every sailing, then sold the passage again on the quay.
Twice the money, and a ghost story to keep anyone from looking. The case of the Ferry's Extra Passenger is closed!
Here is the agency's fee, with my thanks. When you are Champion of another region, come back.
A case from Johto. Every morning, the researchers at the Ruins of Alph find chalk marks on the paving.
Copies of the carvings on the walls, made overnight. Vandals, they say. But vandals do not copy so neatly.
Will you take the case of the Alph Etchings?
Excellent! Speak to the researcher, the camper and the schoolchild who visit the ruins. Each of them has seen something.
Come back when you have found the clues. Then we deduce!
You have every clue! Now, we think. First question.
Precisely! Every copy is labelled, letter by letter, like a blackboard. This is not mischief. It is a lesson!
Second question, and the important one.
Yes! Chalk on her sleeves every morning, and a quiz on the Unown. A teacher brings her class to the ruins by night.
Mirelle Dunn, the schoolteacher. She will be at the ruins. Go and speak to her, {player}. Gently. She means well.
Mirelle Dunn the schoolteacher waits at the Ruins of Alph. Go and speak to her!
There are clues still to find. The researcher, the camper and the schoolchild at the Ruins of Alph.
Miss Dunn and the researchers have made a bargain. Her class may study the ruins by day, and the paving stays clean.
The case of the Alph Etchings is closed! Here is the agency's fee, with my thanks.
When you are Champion of another region, come back. The door is always open.
A case from Hoenn. Crates marked SALT come in to Dewford Town on a little boat. Salt is heavy. These crates are light as air.
Dewford's customs officer is puzzled, and so am I. What weighs nothing and needs a false name?
Will you take the case of the Salt Run?
Excellent! Speak to the customs officer, the sailor and the old fisherman in Dewford Town.
Come back when you have found the clues. Then we deduce!
You have every clue! Now, we think. First question.
Precisely! A second stamp on a customs seal. The crates were opened after customs, and sealed again.
Second question, and the important one.
Yes! The crew sing of lamps, not salt. Lamp parts are light, and they pay a far higher duty.
Skipper Ottoline Marsh. She will be on Dewford Town's shore. Go and face her, {player}. Mind the spray.
Skipper Ottoline Marsh waits on Dewford Town's shore. Go and face her!
There are clues still to find. The customs officer, the sailor and the old fisherman in Dewford Town.
Skipper Marsh has paid her duty in full, and the lamps went where they were meant to: Dewford's own lighthouse keepers.
The case of the Salt Run is closed! Here is the agency's fee, with my thanks.
When you are Champion of another region, come back. The door is always open.
A case from Unova. Two tournaments are booked into the World Tournament for the same afternoon.
Both organisers swear they asked first. Both have the papers to prove it. One of them, or both, has been fooled.
Will you take the case of the Double-Booked Hall?
Excellent! Speak to the two organisers outside the World Tournament, and to the janitor who keeps the keys.
Come back when you have found the clues. Then we deduce!
You have every clue! Now, we think. First question.
Precisely! A name rubbed out and another written over it. The afternoon was sold, then sold again.
Second question, and the important one.
Yes! The office key, taken out after hours on the very night the second booking was written.
Isidore Calloway, the hall's clerk. He will be at the World Tournament's door. Go and face him, {player}!
Isidore Calloway the clerk waits at the World Tournament's door. Go and face him!
There are clues still to find. The two organisers and the janitor, outside the World Tournament.
Mr. Calloway has returned the second fee, and the two organisers have agreed to share the afternoon. One morning, one evening.
The case of the Double-Booked Hall is closed! Here is the agency's fee, with my thanks.
When you are Champion of another region, come back. The door is always open.
A case from Kalos. A painting in Lumiose City's museum leaves its frame every night. By morning, it is back.
Nothing is ever missing when the doors open. And yet the night guard swears the frame is empty at midnight.
Will you take the case of the Borrowed Masterpiece?
Excellent! Speak to the guard by the museum in Lumiose City, then to the porter and the painter in Kiloude City.
Come back when you have found the clues. Then we deduce!
You have every clue! Now, we think. First question.
Precisely! Screws worn bright from turning. The painting is taken out of its frame, and the frame never moves.
Second question, and the important one.
Yes! A long flat parcel on the last train to Kiloude, and back on the first. Only the museum's restorer has the keys.
Odile Ferrand. She will be in Kiloude City's square. Go and face her, {player}!
Odile Ferrand the restorer waits in Kiloude City's square. Go and face her!
There are clues still to find. The guard by Lumiose City's museum, and the porter and the painter in Kiloude City.
Madame Ferrand took the painting to Kiloude so her students could copy it from life. The museum has made her a teacher there.
By day, and with the painting on its wall. The case of the Borrowed Masterpiece is closed! Here is the agency's fee.
You are a detective as much as a Champion, {player}. When you are Champion of another region, come back.
Hmm. No, I do not think that is it. Look over your clues and come back to me. A detective is never in a hurry!
As you wish. The door stays open.
No case waits for you today. When you are Champion of another region, there will be one. There always is.
Boxes stacked to the ceiling, every one stamped CASE CLOSED. Some of the stamps look very old.
Maps of every region, pinned and scribbled over, with string running from town to town.
